answer_1.quote: Understanding structured knowledge, e.g., information encoded in tables, and automatically generating natural-language descriptions is an important task in the area of Natural Language Generation.
answer_1.outputs: natural language text descriptions from tables

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we apply the widely used evaluation metrics including the standard BLEU-4, METEOR and ROUGE scores to evaluate the generation quality.

answer_4.quote: Following , we conduct extensive human evaluation on the generated descriptions and compare the results to the state-of-the-art methods.
answer_4.guideline: The raters are trained with word instructions and text examples of the grading standard beforehand. During evaluation, we randomly sample 100 examples from the predictions of each model on the Wikiperson test set, and provide these examples to the raters for blind testing.
